product_metadata.title: Kate and Laurel Bordeaux Modern Gallery Wall Kit, Set of 10 with Assorted Size Frames with Dark Espresso Finish
features: The Kate and Laurel Bordeaux Frame collection allows you to design a display that not only will add style to a blank wall but will also give you the warm glow of your treasured memories and enhance any room

These well-built wooden frames will complement a dining room, living room or even a nursery. It is sure to bring additional interest and attention, drawing the focus of the moments and memories you've captured in your own custom scheme

The 10 frame set has 5 different outside frame sizes with each frame having one of 3 photo display sizes. The sizes are: (1) 11 x 14 matted, photo display size 7.5 x 9.5; (2) 8 x 10 matted, one photo display size 4.5 x 6.5 and one having two photo displays cut in - each 3.5 x 5.5; (1) 7 x 9 frame matted, photo display size 4.5 x 6.5; (3) 5 x 7 frames unmatted, photo display size 4.5 x 6.5 and (3) 4 x 6 frames unmatted, photo display size 3.5 x 5.5

The sawtooth hanging hardware is already installed on the back for both portrait or landscape style pictures. Hang your pictures using a design that accentuates your decorating style or use the hanging template that comes with the set to make it easier to place your photos in a perfect collection on the wall

The strong structural shape of the Bordeaux frame profile is a classic look that won't date and complements many decorating styles like country, classical, deco, eclectic, European, and traditional. In addition, a beveled off-white mat is included in 4 of the frames including one that has cut outs for two 3.5 x 5.5 photos
description: Family photographs should be displayed where they can be a constant reminder that time spent with family and friends should be remembered and enjoyed by everyone. Sharing those photos is a joy that brings not only you satisfaction but also entertains your guests. Done right, and you have a timeless collection of your best times captured in one lovely customized view on your favorite wall. A pleasure to view everyday and fun to add to over time. The Kate and Laurel Bordeaux frame set helps you tell your story creatively, tastefully and with the theme, you have in mind. Sizes: (1) 11 x 14 matted, photo display size 7.5 x 9.5; (2) 8 x 10 matted, one photo display size 4.5 x 6.5 and one having two photo displays cut in - each 3.5 x 5.5; (1) 7 x 9 frame matted, photo display size 4.5 x 6.5; (3) 5 x 7 frames unmatted, photo display size 4.5 x 6.5 and (3) 4 x 6 frames unmatted, photo display size 3.5 x 5.5
